problem: The customer conversion goals CONTACT/WEBSITE and CONTACT/CALL_FROM_ADS are biddable. Every conversion action inside a biddable goal is counted in the Conversions column and feeds Maximize Clicks conversion reporting, regardless of the action's primary_for_goal flag. That pulls the WhatConverts upload actions and the raw call-button click into the same totals as the landing-page form and the call-from-ads action.

proof.wc_lead_action: 7643656486 'WC Lead' reads primary_for_goal=False and include_in_conversions_metric=False, yet contributed 1.0 to metrics.conversions on 'hvac companies near me open now'.

proposed_change.after: biddable=false on those 10 campaign conversion goals
proposed_change.effect: Primary conversions become exactly the landing-page form lead, the landing-page website call and the call-from-ads action. WhatConverts uploads and the raw call-button click stay visible as secondary diagnostics and stop inflating the bidding total.

risks: Reported Conversions will step DOWN. That is the correction, not a loss.
Maximize Clicks does not bid to conversions, so bidding behaviour does not change today. The correction matters before any move to a conversion-based strategy.
No conversion action is removed, paused or edited. Only goal biddability at campaign level changes.
rollback: Set biddable=true on the same 10 campaign conversion goals.
unrelated_resource_assertions: no conversion action created, removed, paused or edited
the known duplicate form action 6498555481 stays ENABLED and secondary
campaigns, budgets, keywords, ads and assets untouched
void_reason: VOID. WC Lead is already excluded from the Conversions column. No mutation needed.
evidence_that_voided_it: WC Lead conversions by date: 2026-08-20 conversions=1.0; 2026-08-21 x2, 2026-08-22 and 2026-08-25 all conversions=0.0 with all_conversions=1.0 each.
PLAN-B 03F125C189679E35 executed 2026-08-21 00:09 ET. Every WC Lead conversion after that timestamp is correctly excluded.

This also DISPROVES the earlier inference that a biddable CONTACT/WEBSITE goal overrides include_in_conversions_metric=false. CONTACT/WEBSITE is biddable=true on all five campaigns right now, yet the four post-fix conversions did not count.
The single counted conversion is a historical reporting artifact. Google does not restate the historical Conversions column after this configuration change.
